searchText: so just to clarify, NC's change https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5550 is the only thing expected in glam devnet 8 ontop of alpha spec 13 atm? https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/874767108809031740/1539340467919913110 these? not sure if we agreed on those also gas limit schedule would be good to have support for Hey <@358120958726373381>, yesterday I asked clients to wait (until we come to consensus on what we want to do). Given that the Gloas fork on devnet-8 is in <24 hours, I would say that 5533 (gas schedule) and 5550 (nc's fix) are the only expected changes for devnet-8 on top of the alpha.13 release. We will figure out 5553 and 5554 later this week. <@412614104222531604> if you agree with this, we should relay this to clients & ensure they push these changes. yeah thats fine by me but also why not just make a release now with alpha 14? and then alpha 15 if those two other prs make it in? that way we can just point to the release instead of "oh yeah this release + two prs" That's probably what we will do. releases are cheap 😂 just press a button and wait 3 hours I'll discuss it with Jihoon in ~20 minutes. <@412614104222531604> we're going to merge 5545 and 5549, then start the release action. Hopefully that's done within in hour or so.
